{{AoE4Icon|Castle Age}} {{4icons|Imperial Age}} }} The '''Culture Wing''' is an [[Age]]-up [[Technology (Age of Empires IV)|technology]] for the [[Abbasid Dynasty]] in ''[[Age of Empires IV]]'' that can be researched at the [[House of Wisdom]]. It advances the player to the next Age, except when researched in the [[Imperial Age (Age of Empires IV)|Imperial Age]], and adds +5,000 hit points to the House of Wisdom. Additionally, it allows the research of new technologies. == Additional technologies == {| class="fandom-table" !width=25%|{{4icons|Feudal Age|48}} !width=25%|{{4icons|Castle Age|48}} !width=25%|{{4icons|Imperial Age|48}} |- |{{4icons|Preservation of Knowledge}} - Reduces the cost of technologies and House of Wisdom wings by 20% |{{4icons|Algebra}} - Generates resources for each military technology researched |{{4icons|Public Libraries}} - [[Villager (Age of Empires IV)|Villagers]] and [[Trade Caravan]]s gain +2 health per economic upgrade researched |} == Strategy == {{Expand section}} == Changelog == === {{4icons||30}} === * Upon release, it researched in 120 seconds. With [[patch 11009]], it researches in 105 seconds. With [[patch 15.3.8338]], it researches in 100 seconds. * It unlocked Preservation of Knowledge, Medical Centers, and [[Proselytization|Faith]] in the respective Ages. === {{4icons|AE|30}} === * With [[update 6.0.878]], Faith was renamed to Proselytization. === {{4icons|TSA|30}} === * With [[patch 11.1.1201]], Proselytization was moved to the Mosque and replaced with a new technology, Public Libraries. === {{4icons|YFL|30}} === * With [[patch 16.2.10604]], Medical Centers was moved to the Keep and replaced with a new technology, Algebra. == Campaign version == The House of Wisdom appears as the primary landmark in the [[The Sultans Ascend (campaign)|The Sultans Ascend]] campaign. It behaves like the Abbasid House of Wisdom, with each Wing unlocking new technologies per Age. However, the Castle Age and Imperial Age technologies of the Culture Wing are [[Medical Centers]] and [[Ancient Relics]] instead of Algebra and Public Libraries respectively. == Gallery == House of Wisdom Culture Wing AoE4.png|The House of Wisdom when reaching the Feudal Age using the Culture Wing {{Age up (Age of Empires IV)}} [[Category:Abbasid Dynasty]] [[Category:Age-up technologies (Age of Empires IV)]]
